sections.indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Helps loosen phlegm (mucus) and thin bronchial secretions to rid the bronchial passageway of bothersome mucus and make coughs more productive.
sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS Take with a glass of water Adults and children 12 years and over 1 tablet every 4 hour. Max 6 doses Children 6 to under 12 years Do not use Children under 6 years Do not use
sections.warnings_and_cautions: WARNINGS Ask a doctor before use if you have Cough that lasts or chronic such as occurs with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis or emphysema. Cough accompanied by too much phlegm (mucus)
